description: Towards a peer recorded Ed3 segments keep the maximum segment size and may straddle blocks, and spare space gets no PADDING.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ. At 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST that has Ed4 clear, so it is recorded Ed3 (B-0228, B-0408) and our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED, Ed4 clear (B-0139), is queued in a type 8 D_PDU, as in dts-nonarq/warning-reason-0-unknown-type. At 2500, during the burst, the client sends the U_PDU 'segment-me-now' (14 bytes, TTL 0, so TTD 1296002500, A-0089, A-0091) to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3 by non-ARQ: a 20-byte DATA C_PDU whose S_PDU carries the TTD as day 16 mod 16 = 0 and second 2 of that day, sent as 1 at 2-second resolution (A-0161 to A-0163, A-0166), queued with dts.ttd at its TTD. Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1, slot 15, 45000 ms. At 52000 one transmission carries the accept first (expedited, C-0288), then the type 7 C_PDU after it (C-1044), cut at dts.max_segment_size into 8, 8 and 4 bytes with C_PDU ID 0. The peer is recorded Ed3, so no Ed4 sending option is used (C-0554, C-0870, C-1155): the segments are not cut to the blocks, and the second D_PDU (bytes 57 to 88) straddles the boundary at byte 64. Laid out: accept 25 bytes, then 32, 32 and 28: 117 bytes, 2 blocks, 10350 ms; EOT 20, 20, 20 and 10, and each reception window equals its EOT since every copy is in this transmission (C-0350, C-0352). 11 bytes are spare, exactly a PADDING D_PDU, but none goes towards an Ed3 peer (C-0367, C-0055, C-1154) and there is no acknowledgement to repeat, so they are zero filled. Placing the C_PDU empties the queue of TTDs, so dts.ttd is cancelled before the transmit output (C-1050). The link is made when the transmission ends at 62350 (B-0213, B-0400), with the 8-bit family (B-0232). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 64 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500) (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its Ack Data in the header form and 19 bytes plus its Ack Data and CRC-32 in the long form, a PADDING D_PDU 11 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).
